abstract: Covers the W3C Privacy Working Group's Global Privacy Control (GPC) specification, pinned to the Working Draft of 24 September 2026 with a build posture: the Sec-GPC: 1 request header and its server and intermediary rules, the per-navigation gpcAtNavigation cache, navigator.globalPrivacyControl on Navigator and WorkerNavigator, the /.well-known/gpc.json support resource with its gpc and lastUpdate members, the WebDriver extension commands, and the spec's non-normative legal-effects text. The Editor's Draft has the same text, so there is no preview line. The pre-W3C community draft (2020 to 2024, with the version member and no navigation cache) is legacy, with an upgrade checklist. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, the signal, the well-known resource, and server, client and testing implementation with the legal-effects summary.
